data.one_liner: Provides country picker widgets with flags, ISO codes and phone prefixes.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies ready‑made Flutter widgets to select a country via dropdown, dialog or Cupertino picker. It includes flag images and country metadata such as ISO code and phone code.
use_when: You need a quick UI for selecting a country or phone code
You want built‑in flag assets without handling them yourself
avoid_when: You require extensive customization beyond the provided widgets
You need a full localization solution or non‑country data
strengths: Simple API with multiple picker styles
Flag assets bundled with the package
Null‑safe and works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: No built‑in support for custom flag sets
